---
title: "Analyse Case Study: Orben 2019 (NHB)"
format: pdf
---

```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

This document analyses the three multiverse datasets from Orben & Przybylski (2019, *Nature Human Behaviour*): MCS Total, MTF, and YRBS.
The outcome metric used throughout is the regression effect size (`effect`).

---

# MCS Total

```{r mcs-load-data}
mv_mcs <- load_multiverse("orben2019nhb_mcs_total")
mv_mcs
```

## Overview

```{r mcs-decisions-overview}
mv_mcs |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r mcs-multiverse-simple}
#| fig-width: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_mcs, direction = "right")
```

## Existing Methods

### Regression

```{r mcs-regression-fit}
reg_mcs <- calc_regression(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
attr(reg_mcs, "tidy")
```

#### Performance

```{r mcs-regression-performance}
reg_mcs |>
  model_performance()
```

#### Model Fit

```{r mcs-regression-model-check}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12
reg_mcs |>
  check_model()
```

```{r mcs-regression-pred-check}
reg_mcs |>
  check_predictions()
```

```{r mcs-regression-residuals-fitted}
vis_residuals_vs_fitted(reg_mcs)
```

```{r mcs-regression-observed-predicted}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_mcs)
```

```{r mcs-regression-observed-predicted-kde}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_mcs, type = "kde")
```

```{r mcs-regression-observed-predicted-hist-overlapping}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_mcs, type = "hist")
```

```{r mcs-regression-observed-predicted-hist}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_mcs, type = "hist", facet = T)
```

```{r mcs-regression-coefficients}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_mcs)
```

#### Importance

```{r mcs-regression-importance}
regimp_mcs <- calc_regression_importance(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
regimp_mcs
```

```{r mcs-regression-importance-plot}
vis_importance(regimp_mcs)
```

### FANOVA

```{r mcs-fanova-fit}
fanova_mcs <- calc_fanova(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
fanova_mcs
```

```{r mcs-fanova-importance-plot}
fanova_mcs |>
  head(10) |>
  fanova_to_vec() |>
  vis_importance()
```

Only main effects

```{r mcs-fanova-main-effects-plot}
fanova_mcs |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  head(10) |>
  fanova_to_vec() |>
  vis_importance()
```

## Our Framework

```{r mcs-within-bucket}
within_mcs <- calc_within_bucket_variation(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
within_mcs
```

```{r mcs-within-bucket-plot}
vis_importance(within_mcs)
```

```{r mcs-between-bucket}
between_mcs <- calc_between_bucket_variation(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
between_mcs
```

```{r mcs-between-bucket-plot}
vis_importance(between_mcs)
```

### Combine

```{r mcs-combine-importance}
vis_importance_2dim(
  between_mcs,
  fanova_mcs |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```

## Ablation Study

Fix each decision to one option, recompute the importance estimates on the
reduced multiverse, and compare the resulting importance vectors across
methods and across options of the fixed decision.

```{r mcs-ablation-run}
ablation_mcs <- run_ablation_analysis(mv_mcs, colname_metric = "effect")
```

### Inter-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-table}
ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary |>
  mutate(
    fixed_decision_label = if_else(
      fixed_decision == "full_multiverse",
      "full multiverse",
      fixed_decision_label
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method_x,
    method_y,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-inter-method-plot}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
vis_inter_method_stability(ablation_mcs$inter_method_stability_summary) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Intra-method stability

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-table}
ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary |>
  select(
    fixed_decision_label,
    method,
    mean_rank_correlation,
    min_rank_correlation,
    mean_abs_difference
  )
```

```{r mcs-ablation-intra-method-plot}
vis_intra_method_stability(ablation_mcs$intra_method_stability_summary)
```

---
